game_name: Fatal Fury 2 / Garou Densetsu 2 - Arata-naru Tatakai
general_issues: Select fatfury2.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
